An earlier version of the same author's Hunt Down deck 14922 ('You Are Beaten', 31 March 2001); not a repost: this list has The Emperor x2 (not Emperor Palpatine) and Darth Vader's Lightsaber + 1 Vader's Lightsaber (not Vader's Lightsaber x2).
Credited to the existing page Mason Johnson (same name and DeckTech handle Palleon).
